decision_conditions:
The development hereby permitted must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of this permission.


REASON: In order to comply with the provisions of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 (as amended).

<div style="color: rgb(34, 34, 34); font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: small;">The&nbsp;<span class="il">flat</span>&nbsp;<span class="il">roof</span>&nbsp;surfaces of the development hereby approved shall not be used as a terrace, balcony or similar amenity area.</div><div style="color: rgb(34, 34, 34); font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: small;"><br></div><div style="color: rgb(34, 34, 34); font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: small;">REASON: In the interests of neighbours' amenity.</div>

The Development hereby permitted shall only be carried out and completed strictly in accordance with the submitted plans hereby approved and any subsequent approval of details.


REASON: To ensure that the development hereby permitted is carried out in full accordance with the plans hereby approved.

<p><span style="color: rgb(51, 51, 51);">Prior to any above ground works associated with the construction phase of the development, full details, with product specifications and images of samples, of the materials to be used on the external surfaces of the buildings, including glazing and all boundary treatments, shall be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority in writing before any above ground work on the site is commenced. The development shall not be carried out otherwise than in accordance with the details thus approved.</span></p><p><span style="color: rgb(51, 51, 51);"><br></span><span style="color: rgb(51, 51, 51);">REASON: To ensure that the external appearance of the building is satisfactory and does not detract from the character and visual amenity of the surrounding area and significance of the setting of the Victoria Park Conservation Area. These details are required prior to commencement of any above ground works as they are integral to the fabric of the development and cannot, therefore, be dealt with retrospectively.</span></p>

<p><span style="color: rgb(51, 51, 51);">A Final Construction Management Plan (CMP) specifying hours of working, construction traffic routing, measures to prevent dust pollution and contact arrangements between residents and contractors shall be submitted and agreed by the Local Planning Authority prior to the commencement of the development. The CMP shall include the following details:&nbsp; (a) loading and unloading of plant and materials;&nbsp; (b) storage of plant and materials;&nbsp; (c) programme of works (including measures for traffic management);&nbsp; (d) provision of boundary hoarding behind any visibility zones;&nbsp; (e) wheel cleaning provision on site. Construction shall thereafter take place in accordance with the measures identified within the CMP. </span></p><p><span style="color: rgb(51, 51, 51);">REASON: To ensure that during demolition and construction works that there would be no negative amenity or highway impacts as a result of the development. These details are required prior to commencement as they affect the entirety of the construction phase and cannot, therefore, be dealt with retrospectively.</span></p>

<p><span style="color: rgb(51, 51, 51);">No non-road mobile machinery (NRMM) shall be used on the site unless it is compliant with the NRMM Low Emission Zone requirements (or any superseding requirements) and until it has been registered for use on the site on the NRMM register (or any superseding register).&nbsp; </span></p><p><span style="color: rgb(51, 51, 51);">REASON: To ensure that air quality is not adversely affected by the development in line with Policy SI 1 of the London Plan (2021) and the Mayor's The Control of Dust and Emissions During Construction and Demolition SPG (2014).</span></p>

<p><span style="color: rgb(51, 51, 51);">Prior to the first occupation of the development hereby approved, the cycle parking hereby approved shall have been implemented. The development shall thereafter be kept free from obstruction and retained solely for its designated use. </span></p><p><span style="color: rgb(51, 51, 51);">REASON: To ensure adequate provision for the safe and secure storage of bicycles, to promote sustainable modes of transport and in the interest of safeguarding highway safety in accordance with Policy LP42 of the Hackney Local Plan 2033 (2020)</span></p>

<p><span style="color: rgb(51, 51, 51);">Prior to the first occupation of the development hereby approved, the refuse and recycling storage hereby approved shall have been implemented. The store shall thereafter be kept free from obstruction and retained solely for its designated use. </span></p><p><span style="color: rgb(51, 51, 51);">REASON:&nbsp;</span><span style="color: rgb(51, 51, 51);">To ensure adequate provision for refuse and recycling is provided which would safeguard the amenity of the area and not compromise pedestrian safety.</span></p>

<p><span style="color: rgb(51, 51, 51);">The development hereby approved shall provide two swift boxes close to the eaves prior to first occupation and shall be retained as such in perpetuity. </span></p><p><span style="color: rgb(51, 51, 51);">REASON: To promote biodiversity on site in line with policy LP46 of the Hackney Local Plan 2033 (2020)</span></p>
description: Erection of an end-of-terrace, single storey above basement level self build dwelling with associated bin store, bike store, photovoltaic panels, air source heat pumps, landscaping works and the creation of an on-site parking space.
